div.div:
Rules Automatic → code is NULL; selected rooms allowed. Code → code required; all rooms only.
UQ (hotel_id, normalized_code). One redemption per booking; no stacking. Room targets must belong to the same hotel.
¹ Usage counters are optional implementation support for code limits; composite keys shown are proposed.
Redemption: reserved → redeemed or released. Both modes keep history. Automatic offers have no use limits in v1. Booking JSON preserves original terms and allocations.
Crow’s foot: circle = zero; bar = one; fork = many. Context-only buyer/hotel/audit FKs are named in rows; their extra lines are omitted.
Source: docs/plan/discount-feature.md. Proposed design, not an extracted database schema.
